# Grow

> Grow is a declarative, file-based Python static site generator with built-in internationalization (i18n), Jinja2 templates, and clean static builds. Created by Blinkk.

Note: Grow is in maintenance mode. For new projects, Blinkk recommends [Root.js](https://rootjs.dev).

## Install

```bash
uv tool install grow
```
